PRE-DRAFT — Firefox Mobile MAU forecast through 2027 (organic + paid)

A forecast of Firefox Mobile monthly active users (MAU) from 2026-10-09 through 2027-12-31, for the four mobile apps together and each on its own, in Glean telemetry terms. Total = organic + paid, built from two sources: the organic part is our model (the production mobile model on real Glean history from 2020-12-31, with Firefox Android's history reduced to its organic share before fitting); the paid part is the marketing data-science team's 2027 plan for paid Firefox Android MAU (Optimized for Dec-15 MAU, UAC + Meta Android, attributed basis), added on top as a level, with their own 2026 run bridging from our data edge to January. The other three apps carry no paid acquisition. The number to read is the raw daily MAU on 2027-12-15.

Pre-draft. Neither half is backtested yet. Organic: the model's own 90% band is quoted (Prophet predictive, uncalibrated). Paid: the plan's own 90% band is quoted (their curve uncertainty only; they call their intervals indicative). The total band treats the two as independent and says so. Data treatments in the organic half: the 2026 Iran internet shutdown is bridged in training; and in India and Indonesia, where organic Firefox Android outgrew the same country's Firefox iOS during 2026 in a way consistent with campaign installs arriving outside the Play Store, organic history from 2026-04-01 is split into an authentic part (held to the country's own iOS growth; this is what the model forecasts) and an inauthentic part (the excess, 440,081 MAU at the edge, in neither our model nor marketing's plan), which is carried flat through 2027 as its own column — a documented no-information choice, provisional and under review with the marketing DS team. Use the curves for shape and magnitude; do not quote them as plan numbers.
Data in this package: glean2027_mobile_mau_forecast.csv — every day from 2020-12-31 to 2027-12-31, history and forecast, total / organic / paid for all apps and per app, plus the 90% bands; glean2027_mobile_mau_by_country.csv — total per country; plots/ — the charts. Beside this package, glean2027_mau_desktop_and_mobile.csv puts the desktop and mobile world curves side by side. Details in section 4.
Seam step -1.4%. The total opens 1.4% below the last week of history (7-day means): organic -1.5%, paid -0.6%. The organic model deliberately does not carry all of the 2026 rise into 2027; read the first weeks as the model's view of the underlying level.

4. How to use the files

  • glean2027_mobile_mau_forecast.csv — one row per day from 2020-12-31 to 2027-12-31: date, data_type (training = history, forecast), then for world, fenix_android, firefox_ios, focus_android, focus_ios the columns total_, organic_ (authentic), organic_inauthentic_, paid_, with total = organic + organic_inauthentic + paid on every row; and total_world_low_90 / high_90, organic_world_low_90 / high_90, paid_world_low_90 / high_90 on forecast rows. Values are the raw daily value of the rolling 28-day MAU, whole people. On history rows total is the real actual and paid is the measured paid; on forecast rows paid is the marketing plan and the inauthentic column is flat.
  • glean2027_mobile_mau_by_country.csv — total per country (all apps) from 2024-01-01, plus world.
  • glean2027_mau_desktop_and_mobile.csv (next to this package) — date, desktop_data_type, desktop_mau, mobile_data_type, mobile_mau (total), mobile_organic_mau, mobile_paid_mau. Do not add desktop and mobile: a person active on both devices is counted in both.
  • Read the 2027-12-15 row for the headline; data_type says where history ends (2026-10-09). MAU is already a 28-day quantity; do not smooth it again.
  • Quote the all-apps total. The split is there so any piece can be swapped: a new marketing scenario replaces the paid_ columns one for one; a different reading of the India/Indonesia excess replaces organic_inauthentic_.

5. What is and is not in it

  • Mobile only: Firefox Android (Fenix), Firefox iOS, Focus Android, Focus iOS; no other mobile product, matching the regular monthly forecast's universe.
  • Paid = the marketing team's plan as delivered (scenario opt_dec15_mau, curves 2026-10-12, MAU = paid DAU × 4.792): a hypothetical with no seasonality and no cross-channel interaction (their words: an upper bound), MAU as a global multiplier rather than a model. The plan starts 2027-01-01; October–December 2026 is the same model's 2026 run.
  • No other adjustments (launches, headwinds). The regular monthly mobile DAU forecast carries those; this one does not.
  • Not backtested; the per-app split is affected by how the model reconciles tiles, so the all-apps figure is the one to quote.
